# Test Fixtures

Only add score images and ground truth when redistribution is permitted. Otherwise document how to obtain the sample or keep it outside the repository and mark the integration test accordingly. Avoid committing copyrighted scores without permission.

MusicXML (`.musicxml`, `.mxl`) fixtures may be committed here when they are synthetic or otherwise redistributable; record their provenance and license next to the fixture. Engine output belongs in the ignored `runs/`, `outputs/`, or `tmp/` directories, never here.
